verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents its own revenue forecasting: predicting team revenue for a given timeframe, AI predictive forecasting, and Copilot insights into forecasts. None of the evidence shows that forecasts are built from pipeline value, stage probabilities and close dates, so only the core forecasting outcome is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented use of pipeline value and stage-probability weighting, close-date-driven forecast periods, forecast configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates
